name: Nkonyane Musa
bio:
Musa is a civil engineer, program & project manager, public private partnership specialist with extensive experience in leadership, corporate strategy and managing complex infrastructure projects. He has vast experience in implementing projects in the Health Sector, Agriculture Sector, Mining Sector, Energy Sector, Water Infrastructure Sector, Commercial and Industrial Sector and the Transportation Sector.

He has led as a Director of Engineering at local government responsible for leading a diverse team, MTEF budgeting, implementing the IDP (2025–2030) for Manzini Municipality, implementing and managing the city infrastructure assets.

name: Frans Pienaar
bio: Frans Pienaar, a Swazi citizen, is currently an Investor and Independent Director with over 30 years’ experience in the construction and built environment. He has served as Inyatsi Construction Group Chairman from December 2012 – October 2016. Having attained a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Stellenbosch University in 1987, he obtained registration as a Professional Engineer with the Engineering Council of South Africa in 1993 and a Full Member of the South African Institution of Civil Engineers in 2003 and was elected as a Member of the Institute of Directors in Southern Africa in July 2006. Frans also serves on several boards as a Board Director – Chairman of the Board of Challenge Ministries Swaziland; Chairman of Board – The Luke Commission; Chairman – Bulembu Ministries and Board of Directors – Royal Eswatini National Airways Corporation (Renac).
